description: (0.5.0, Draft) Fail-open by default, fail-closed by configuration, idempotent retries, and publish before the final chunk (RFC-ACDP-0022 §6–§6.2).

input.note: Run the agent against a test registry, with a client that sends the a2a-001 task (two chunks for artifactId fraud-summary) unless a scenario says otherwise.

expected.behavior: The registry answers 429 rate_limited after retries: the artifact is emitted unchanged with io.acdp/provenance = {failed: true, error: "rate_limited"}.
Connection refused or the publish timeout elapses: {failed: true} with no error member.
For an artifact configured fail-closed, the parts are never emitted; the agent may end the task TASK_STATE_FAILED with a status message naming the failure.
Retries resend the byte-identical body with Idempotency-Key acdp-a2a-<content_hash hex>; the registry returns the original ctx_id.

scenarios.name: E — publish before the final chunk

expected.behavior: The lastChunk chunk, and any snapshot carrying the completed artifact, is emitted only after the publish response; a slow registry delays the final chunk rather than producing a link to an unpublished body.
